|lead='''Luke Skywalker''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] — [[Rebel]] released as an ultra-rare foil in [[Reflections]] in January 2000. It is a foil printing of the [[Premiere]] card.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 29–32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 5, 20–22, 34–35, 39–41, 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
|lore=Son of Anakin Skywalker. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Honed piloting skills while bullseyeing womp rats in Beggar's Canyon aboard T-16 skyhopper.
|game_text=You may activate 1 extra Force each turn if Luke is not at a Tatooine site. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition &lt; 3.
|errata_history=This physical foil prints the replacement text published in [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Decipher’s Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 89. Its activation condition is “not at a Tatooine site”; the original [[Luke Skywalker|Premiere Limited card]] requires Luke to be “present at any non-Tatooine location”. It also changes “any starship he pilots” to “anything he pilots” and “On Red 5” to “When piloting Red 5”.<ref name="decipher-1998">[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 1–2 and 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="wording-faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|English Reflections foil]] and [[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Reflections III foil]].</ref>

The [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)|Japanese Reflections III foil]] retains the earlier Japanese text: Luke must be at a location other than Tatooine, and the piloting bonus names a starship. Its later release date does not mean its printed text incorporates the English foil’s revisions. The later digital rendering on [[Luke Skywalker (Errata)]] uses the PC rulebook wording about total Force generation, which is not printed on this physical foil.<ref name="wording-faces" />
